name: mirage
text: Seen the screenshot: the Kalshi card lacks the X, the in-game chip and the Bet / Open buttons the Novig card has, and its Bet opens a different, bigger sheet. Plan: (1) the Kalshi card gets the same X, chip and buttons; (2) its Bet opens the same mini slip (same layout, Kalshi's price and fee in it); (3) X removes a bet for good on both, surviving rescans; (4) a slip that finds a bet unbettable drops it from the list at once and it only returns after a fresh price shows it bettable. Building it now in one release.
